rationale: Form with double overlines suggesting abbreviation. Closes the chapter on the eschatological fate of sinners (transmigration). Most plausible readings: (a) abbreviated Greek-derived term for 'decree/judgment'; (b) Lyc. ⲧⲛⲟ 'manner'; (c) ⲇⲩⲛⲁⲙⲓⲥ 'power' contracted. Translated tentatively 'sentencing' to fit eschatological-juridical context. Confidence low; flagged for parallel attestations.

Lycopolitan variant of ⲡⲣⲙ̄ⲛ̄ⲃⲣ̄ⲡⲉ (the Pauline καινὸς ἄνθρωπος, in glossary). The form ⲃϥ̄ⲣⲉ for ⲃⲣ̄ⲡⲉ/ⲃⲣ̄ⲣⲉ shows scribal/dialectal vowel-form variation on the same root for 'new.' Same theological referent: the renewed cosmic-anthropological identity into which the Elect are gathered.
Recurring directional ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ 'upward' is well-attested. Document the variant ⲁⲍⲣ followed by lacuna in line 9 as part of the standard upward-conveyance vocabulary.

Likely ⲡⲥ-ⲙⲉⲓⲛⲉ 'the sign' or substantival noun of ⲥⲙⲓⲛⲉ 'establish,' giving 'the establishment/manifestation.' Functions in the correspondential identification: 'this [cloud] IS the sign of the gazing of the Virgin of Light.' Cf. similar ⲡⲥⲙⲉⲛⲉ formations in adjacent passages.
